summary: This contemporary well proportioned, three bedroom townhouse situated in a new development, with good road access onto the main arterial routes A1 north and south making the Metrocentre and Newcastle International Airport easily within reach..
description:
The property benefits from central heating and double glazing throughout with the accommodation comprising: On the ground floor there is a light and airy living room with double glazed patio doors to the rear garden, generous breakfasting/dining kitchen with fitted kitchen and downstairs WC. The first floor has two double bedrooms and family bathroom with mains power shower over whilst to the top floor there is a well appointed master bedroom with en-suite shower room and walk in closet. Externally there is a very pleasant west facing rear garden with a paved patio area and, borders of shrubs and flowers all bounded by a brick wall and wooden fencing with a rear gate leading onto the off allocated street parking. EPC RatingC Council Tax C Service Charges are approx £17.00 pcm Freehold

LET AT £850.00 PCM ON A ROLLING CONTRACT BASIS
